craft_notes: Sthāyin: rule-joy. Whole-pāda fusion sung whole. Close: prevailing. Rejected: 'ritual' — killed.

lines: Thus worship told; in fire-rite too this way:
who worship-rule hath done, the seed recalls aright, prevails.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yajanamākhyātamagnikārye'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījaṃ prasidhyati |

reads_against.argmap: Worship told in fire-rite even this rule; whose rule done, rightly remembering seed, succeeds.
c1_essence: Worship told; fire-rite rule; seed remembered rightly succeeds.
